rows.ARS:
Orange-pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MACsweetwa
Exhibition name: Sweetwaters
rows.Origin: Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1978).
rows.Bloom: Orange-pink. Mild fragrance. 26 to 40 petals. Large, full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Tall, upright. Large, glossy, dark green foliage.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Patents:
New Zealand - Patent No: 417 on 14 Jul 1988
Application No: ROS209 on 4 Oct 1985
Trade Name: Sweetwaters. PVR Terminated: July 14, 1991.
rows.Notes: According to the New Zealand Plant Variety Rights (PVR) web page, application for a PVR Grant for this rose was made in 1985 and granted in 1988 (PVR Grant No. 417). This PVR Grant was surrendered in 1991.
